Sets the cells of a given value of a raster to novalue, or all the other cells.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Null, Novalue, Mask, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterNull`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to modify. |
| `pValue` | Double |  |  | The value to set to null. |
| `pNull` | Double |  |  | An optional value to give to the nulled cells instead of the novalue. |
| `doInverse` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, keeps the cells of the value and sets all the others to null. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The new raster. |
